facts.claim: Wonder of the Seas (Royal Caribbean): Entered service 2022; 236,857 GT; 5734 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 362 m length; Oasis class.
Introducing the new Oasis Class Cruise Ship, Wonder of the Seas. Register to get updates on future sailings in China and the Asia region.
Wonder of the Seas is a cruise ship operated by Royal Caribbean International.
At 235,600 GT, she was the largest cruise ship by gross tonnage, until she was surpassed in 2024 by the Icon-class cruise ship, Icon of the Seas, also owned by Royal Caribbean International.

catalogSpecs.description: A large cruise ship launched in 2022. Features multiple themed neighborhoods including dedicated suite areas.
